_comment: ACP agent launch configs. Commands/versions come from the ACP registry (registry-main/<id>/agent.json). skill_dir is where THAT agent looks for project skills relative to the session cwd (workspace/) — this is the per-harness 'mounting glue' that differs even though the SKILL.md itself is identical. `install` + `configure` declare how the desktop UI bootstraps each agent (Install/Configure buttons on the harness card).

claude.name: Claude Agent (claude-acp)
claude.auth: Run `claude login` first (Pro/Max), or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The agent handles its own auth (ACP 'Agent Auth').

codex.name: Codex CLI (codex-acp)
codex.auth: Run `codex login` first (ChatGPT/Codex subscription), or set OPENAI_API_KEY.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI (gemini)
gemini.auth: Google login via the gemini CLI (free tier) or GEMINI_API_KEY. The agent handles its own auth.

qwen.name: Qwen Code (qwen-code)
qwen.auth: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in .env (Qwen OAuth free tier ended Apr 15 2026). Gemini-CLI fork; native --experimental-skills.
qwen.note: Qwen brain — pairs with your local Ollama qwen3.5.

opencode.name: OpenCode (model-agnostic)
opencode.auth: Model-agnostic (75+ providers incl. local). For a zero-key local brain, configure an Ollama provider (http://localhost:11434/v1).

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot.auth: GitHub Copilot subscription (gh auth login with Copilot enabled) or GH_TOKEN.

deepagents.name: DeepAgents (LangChain, model-agnostic)
deepagents.auth: Model-agnostic via LangChain (any provider key, or local).
deepagents.note: This is LangChain's DeepAgents, NOT the Pydantic-AI agent. The Pydantic ACP agent (pydantic-deep) is not in the registry — it would be wired hors-registry (uvx/python).

openclaw.name: OpenClaw Gateway (openclaw acp)
openclaw.auth: Needs openclaw installed + a running OpenClaw Gateway + token (--token-file ~/.openclaw/gateway.token, or OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN / OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD).
openclaw.note: ACP-capable but a BRIDGE: `openclaw acp` speaks ACP over stdio and forwards prompts to the Gateway over WebSocket — NOT self-contained. Driving it nests OpenClaw's whole runtime (channels, memory, its own sub-agents/harnesses) as ONE agent behind your client. **Skill discovery caveat**: OpenClaw resolves its agent workspace via `resolveAgentWorkspaceDir(cfg)` (config-driven, typically `~/.openclaw/workspace-<id>/`) — the cwd we spawn it with is IGNORED. So Split's session-scoped `.agents/skills/` is invisible to OpenClaw; only skills under its own workspace + `~/.openclaw/skills` + `~/.agents/skills` are seen. Skill injection per-session would require driving the Gateway's config (out of scope). Reserve — Gateway not running here. Hors-registry.

mistral-vibe.name: Mistral Vibe (vibe-acp)
mistral-vibe.auth: Set MISTRAL_API_KEY (cloud). Download the vibe-acp binary into var/bin/ first — see README.
mistral-vibe.note: No npx distribution; ships as a platform binary. Vibe scans its own `.vibe/` config dir for skills + agent instructions, so `skill_dir = .vibe/skills` and `install_persona` also projects the persona into `<ws>/.vibe/AGENTS.md` (in addition to the universal `<ws>/AGENTS.md`). See split/core.py:install_persona.
